task.title: Guard every hidden-toggled board class with a [hidden] rule
task.description: The board's fake DOM in internal/webui/handler_test.go has no layout engine, so a client test can only see the hidden property, never whether an element left the screen. On the filter-row branch the Labels menu's rows flipped hidden and kept rendering because .filter-option sets display: flex and had no .filter-option[hidden] { display: none; } companion; the same rule kept the No labels match line permanently visible. TestHandlerEveryHiddenToggledClassHidesWhenHidden now pins six hand-listed classes. Replace the hand list with a real guard: parse the served stylesheet, find every class that declares display and that the client script toggles .hidden on (or the template ships with a hidden attribute), and require the [hidden] companion for each. Found by Dylan testing PR #151 locally.
